privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: Folio is a portfolio project: a working example of a book shop. Orders are not really shipped and no money is taken. This page explains what the site stores and why.

sections.title: What we store
items: Account: your name, email and password (the password is only ever stored hashed). If you sign in with Google, we receive only your name, email and profile photo from Google.
Orders: first and last name, email, phone, delivery address and note, and the books you ordered.
Your account area: the addresses you add, your cart and your favourites.
Reviews: your rating and text, published under your first name.
Newsletter and stock alerts: the email you leave and the language of the site, until you ask us to remove it.
No payment details are stored — the site never asks for card data.

sections.title: Why we use it
items: To recognise you and sign you in.
To place your order and show it in your account.
To keep your cart and favourites across devices.
We do not sell your data, use it for advertising or share it with third parties.

sections.title: Where it is kept
items: Data is stored in a Supabase database; each user can read only their own records.
The site is hosted on Vercel. Google sign-in happens on Google's own page; your Google password never reaches us.

sections.title: In your browser
items: Your language, theme (dark/light), cart and favourites are kept in the browser's storage (localStorage).
No tracking or advertising cookies are used.

sections.title: Your rights
items: You can change or remove your profile and addresses in your account at any time.
To have your account and all your data deleted, write to {{email}} — it will be removed within a few days.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: Folio is a portfolio project that works like a real book shop. By using the site you accept these terms.

sections.title: About the shop
items: Folio shows how an online book shop works from catalogue to order. Books are not really shipped and no money is taken.
Prices, stock and delivery times are examples. They may change without notice.

sections.title: Your account
items: Give a real email and keep your password to yourself; you are responsible for what is done with your account.
You may sign up with email and password or with Google. One person, one account.
We may close accounts that are used to harm the site or other readers.

sections.title: Orders
items: An order is a request; it is confirmed when the shop changes its status. While it is still "Received" you can cancel it in your account.
Promo codes take a percentage off the books, not the delivery. One code per order; codes can expire or run out.
If a book runs out while you order, the order is not placed and you are told which book it was.

sections.title: Reviews
items: Only readers who ordered a book can review it. Reviews appear under your first name.
Be fair and keep to the book: insults, advertising and other people's personal data are removed.
You can edit or delete your review at any time.

sections.title: Content
items: Book descriptions, quotations and author biographies are given for introduction. The classic texts are in the public domain; the cover art was made for this site.
Do not copy the site's design or code for commercial use without asking.

sections.title: Changes and contact
items: These terms may be updated; the date at the top shows the latest version.
Questions or complaints: write to {{email}}.
